plates.name: Castle Street — exterior, wet, with the arch
plates.note: The grey half of the cold open. The arch is the only warm thing in frame and the gold spills onto the wet pavement — the transition made physical, so the push-in has somewhere to travel FROM.

plates.name: Castle Arcade — interior wide
plates.outstanding: The fascia lettering renders as 'Thistlewad's'. Repaint the lettering only — never re-roll, because the shop order is the expensive part of this image and a re-roll risks losing it.

plates.name: Shopfront — exterior master
plates.provenance: This is the 17 July original, byte-identical to the old 'Front Of The Shop'. Julian reviewed and accepted it as-is 2026-08-13 rather than regenerating.

plates.name: Front Room (public shop) — interior master
plates.provenance: 17 July original, byte-identical to the old 'Inside Shop'. Accepted as-is 2026-08-13.
plates.note: The most-used interior in the episode — four of Act One's five shots plus the closing image.

plates.name: Workshop — occupied
plates.NEVER: Never an anchor for a scripted shot. It depicts Richard carrying the box into the workshop past four children — a moment that occurs nowhere in script or manuscript.

plates.name: Workshop — clean, door DORMANT
plates.note: The door is dark and inert, and the workbench is EMPTY. Both matter: the empty bench is the cold open's punchline ('There's nothing on the bench') and the dark door protects the reveal.

plates.name: Workshop — clean, door BACKLIT
plates.note: A thin seam of other-coloured light around a CLOSED door. Matches the script as written rather than approximating it.

DOOR_STATE_LAW.rule: The back door has exactly two states and the wrong one spoils the episode.
DOOR_STATE_LAW.dormant: PL-06. Everything before Tom Chen leaves. The door is furniture.
DOOR_STATE_LAW.backlit: PL-07. Only from the moment the shop door clicks shut behind Tom.
DOOR_STATE_LAW.why: The door's glow is the cold open's payoff and Act One's turn. If it is already lit in the opening minute, the episode spends its biggest moment before the title card.

COVERAGE.act_two: NONE — Burgundy village, atelier, market and bridge are all unbuilt. Costumes approved.
COVERAGE.act_three_and_tag: Covered by PL-04, PL-06 and PL-07. Mrs Patel has no design.

keyframes._note: Anchors. One per shot, because both working routes accept a single reference image.
